name: fhevm-age-dapp
description: This is a privacy age verification dApp built with FHEVM, where user data is encrypted and calculated without leakage.

paragraphs: FHEVM Age Verifier is a privacy-preserving decentralized application (dApp) built using Zama's Fully Homomorphic Encryption Virtual Machine (FHEVM). This dApp demonstrates a real-world use case for confidential computing on the blockchain: age verification without revealing sensitive user data. Users input their age, which is encrypted client-side using the FHEVM SDK. The smart contract performs homomorphic operations (e.g., comparison age >= 18) directly on the encrypted data, ensuring no plaintext age is exposed on-chain or to the relayer. Only the boolean result (eligible or not) is…

This project was developed as part of the Zama Developer Program Builder Track, showcasing FHEVM's potential for secure, scalable privacy in DeFi, social apps, and compliance tools (e.g., KYC without data leaks). It's deployed on Sepolia testnet for demonstration.
